children: Essential Utilities filed a joint petition for a non-unanimous settlement in the Pennsylvania Public Utility Commission review of its proposed merger with American Water.
American Water, Essential Utilities and affiliates submitted a joint petition for a non-unanimous settlement in the PaPUC merger proceeding.
The settlement was agreed with the Bureau of Investigation and Enforcement, Consumer Advocate, Small Business Advocate and other parties.
One or more parties did not join; the Administrative Law Judges will review and issue a Recommended Decision to the PaPUC.
The PaPUC must review and approve the Settlement Agreement for the merger approval process to proceed.
